net_working_internet_desc: You can install OpenWrt later to have a federated private network between villages. The internal node name does not change. OpenWrt only redirects the subdomain.
net_my_info_desc: These are your node's network data. They serve so that other villages can find this node and know its services. This is not federation — it is your node's network registry. To federate with another village, use the Federate Villages tab.
net_internet_desc: How to find you over the public Internet. Does not require OpenWrt.
net_public_domain_hint: More friendly domain if you have OpenWrt configured.
net_intranet_desc: How to find you over the private intranet between villages using WireGuard. Does not use the public Internet — creates a parallel Internet between villages. Only applies if you have OpenWrt installed.
net_no_openwrt: You do not have OpenWrt configured.
net_no_openwrt_hint: If you want to create a private intranet between villages (that works without public Internet), install OpenWrt using the OpenWrt Installer tab.
net_federate_hint: To federate with another village: Use the Federate Villages tab in the Federation menu. There you can add the other village's data (domain, IPv6 ULA, WireGuard) to establish federation.
net_mode_hint: The node works without OpenWrt. Switch to Intranet when OpenWrt is installed.
net_ula_hint: Unique prefix for the village. No collisions between villages.
net_openwrt_hint: The internal node name does not change. OpenWrt only redirects the subdomain to the node.
net_services_desc: Register village services in the OpenWrt DNS. Each service gets a subdomain with automatic SSL.
net_image_for_village_desc: Generate an OpenWrt image with the current configuration of this village.
net_image_new_village_desc: Generate a pre-configured image to deliver to another village. Includes new IPv6 ULA and WireGuard keys, pre-federated with this village.
net_domain_and_key_required: Domain and public key are required
